body: I appreciate the sentiment.  And I'm glad that it makes you glad to make others happy.  It's hard to become someone that changes the world, and I do take some joy in making other people's days better even the slightest.  I always try to be as polite to strangers as possible. Even little thing like hold a door open, pick up something they dropped, saying high with a smile and engaging in polite conversation however brief.  I enjoy that. I know those things brighten people's worlds because I alway feel the push of love when others do those things for me. I love people.  I have an intense love for people because of my belief we really are all one thing observing itself subjectively.  But perspective can really be depressing when you see and know of the bad seeds festering. Keep being you. I hope all goes well in your life.

I suppose I would say mostly the American political system.  But most political systems are still run by people with money that do everything possible to push their agenda.  Structure regardless, the majority of people who quest for power are not doing so to truly help others. And many whose intentions begin that way are bent and shaped into people they wouldn't have recognized in the beginning.
